answer: An answer must include the first 26 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the wander derivation is checked against the beacon nonce, the juniper audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 44 aliases produces 44 mismatches and forfeits the authoring cost with no payout. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
